commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 32 despite Nifty reclaiming 23,000, market health displays classic late-stage divergence. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil caution against aggressive buying when headline indices mask underlying distribution across broader small and mid-caps. Heavy crude prices ($116-$117/bbl) add severe macro friction. In this defensive posture, Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate keeping cash reserves high, demanding strict confirmation at pivot breakouts, and never compromising on earnings quality. Leaders must show explosive, verified EPS and sales acceleration; any candidate lacking institutional earnings confirmation must be capped at Watch.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Forming a double-bottom base above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume expanded 2.42x on the swing reclaim with MACD positive, but lacks high-tight consolidation tightness.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Capital market investment firm with historically erratic revenues and negative operating track record. Turnaround in Q2 FY27 requires sustained operating validation, low institutional float.
21STCENMGM.risk: Fails on close below 47.58 stop; tight risk discipline essential given speculative small-cap profile.

63MOONS.technical: Double bottom structure reclaiming the rising 21-EMA near prior highs. Moving averages stacked positively, but price remains prone to wide, loose swings.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite strong top-line recovery in brokerage software solutions, net bottom-line performance remains severely negative with poor ROE (1.5%) and lack of sustained operational profitability.
63MOONS.risk: Violation of 849.29 stop breaches moving average support, invalidating double-bottom thesis.

AAATECH.technical: Clearing a 20-day high with 1.85x volume expansion. Price holds above key EMAs with RSI at 62 confirming constructive upward momentum without being overextended.
AAATECH.fundamental: IT security firm with CERT-In empanelment and debt-free balance sheet, but sub-10% ROE and modest five-year sales growth lack true CANSLIM institutional momentum.
AAATECH.risk: A drop below the 102.52 stop aborts the breakout attempt.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: High-volume SEPA breakout (67.7x 20-day volume) clearing a 20-day high. Moving averages are in Stage 2 alignment with solid RS momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: API manufacturer registering decent 19% sales expansion, but net earnings contraction (-4.1% YoY) and moderate single-digit margins fail O'Neil's 25% minimum profit growth threshold.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Breakdown below 420.40 invalidates the volume breakout and requires instant exit.

ABDL.technical: Double bottom pattern pressing the 767.67 neckline on 1.46x volume. Trades cleanly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA in Stage 2 posture.
ABDL.fundamental: Topline volume crossed 10 million cases (+15.8% revenue), but gross margin pressures and negative EPS growth trend keep fundamental qualification capped under CANSLIM rules.
ABDL.risk: Failure to hold 705.04 stop invalidates the double-bottom base support.

ACUTAAS.technical: Classic Stage 2 institutional advance breaking out of a double-bottom base on 3.67x volume. Stacking 21-EMA and 50-SMA reflects powerful relative strength.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Elite CANSLIM metrics: consecutive quarters of >60% EPS expansion, 42.7% sales growth, 31.6% ROCE, expanding 34% EBITDA margins, and pristine debt-free balance sheet with high institutional inflows.
ACUTAAS.risk: A close below the 3555.57 stop indicates pivot failure requiring defensive capital preservation.
